import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
data = data[data['Core Based Statistical Area (CBSA)'].notna()]
data = data[~data['Core Based Statistical Area (CBSA)'].astype(str).str.contains('µg/m3|ppb|ppm|CO -|Lead -|NO2|Ozone|PM10|PM2.5|SO2|IN -|ND -', na=False)]

row = data[data['Core Based Statistical Area (CBSA)'].astype(str).str.startswith('Albuquerque')]
result = int(row['Population (2020 Census)'].values[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()

ozone_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Ozone' in c][0]
city_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Core Based Statistical Area' in c][0]

targets = ['Austin-Round Rock-Georgetown, TX', 'Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington, TX']
subset = data[data[city_col].isin(targets)].copy()
subset[ozone_col] = pd.to_numeric(subset[ozone_col], errors='coerce')
result = subset.sort_values(by=ozone_col, ascending=False).iloc[0][city_col]
